name: Eagle Foothills
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: An Idaho AVA northwest of Boise and the first sub-appellation of the Snake River Valley AVA. The climate is cool, and most vines are at one vineyard in the center.
